dogecoin.text: @failtastic_32 Well it looks like @Gemini is adding Doge which is kinda crazy. They are the strictest and most compliant US exchange so I think in a way that helps legitimize Dogecoin even further.

I still can’t get over the fact that @Gemini is adding Dogecoin. Props to @tyler and @cameron for recognizing what the market wants. I’m still unsure of what the future of Doge will be, but this speaks to the power of network effects and a strong community.

Hot take: Dogecoin is much less inflationary than people believe. 

Yes 5B coins are added every year, but that means over time the % increase of new coins goes down. As long as the protocol never changes, it’s actually deflationary compared to fiat.
If people didn’t learn the lesson with GameStop, I hope they do with Dogecoin. Robinhood lost a lot of investor trust and continues to show they don’t have it back. https://t.co/W6m7vxX3UF

This is also another nail in the coffin for Robinhood crypto assets. You don’t have access to your coins and now you cannot earn any yield on them. Well done to @Gemini for being forward thinking and giving the Dogecoin community more financial services for their portfolios.
